title: The Lumen Throne Canon
summary: A canon of light as command: a field so bright that foes bow their heads and lose their will to press forward.

title: Treatise of the Mirror Dawn
summary: A treatise on turning a foe's own force and light back on them through a field of polished brightness.

title: The Dazzling Sovereign's Mastery
summary: A mastery of blinding and bewildering light that ends a fight before the foe has found the ground.

title: The Healing Aureole Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the ring of healing light that mends the wounded and holds a dying breath until help comes.

title: Canon of the Day Lance
summary: A canon of the great lance of daylight that gathers the whole field into one straight thrust.

title: The Oath of the Naked Light
summary: A sworn manual of light with nothing hidden in it; the user shows every blow and still no guard can answer.

title: Treatise on Wind-Borne Radiance
summary: A treatise on riding the speed of light across open ground and leaving a blow behind where the user was.

title: Mastery of the Burning Mirror
summary: A mastery of gathering light in a great mirror of the field and burning a single point to ash.

title: Manual of the Aureole Guard
summary: A manual of the ring of light that drinks a blow whole and turns its weight into brightness.

title: The Beacon-Keeper's Canon
summary: A canon of the standing light that guides allies through the dark and marks every foe for the one who holds it.
